finalists.label: Biliary cystadenoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including mucinous fluid and membranes extracted and a multiloculated lesion communicating with the biliary bifurcation.

finalists.label: Cholangitis
finalists.why: It has several for entries, including obstructive jaundice and moderate hepatocellular enzyme elevations and cholestasis, with no against entries.

finalists.label: Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including mucinous fluid and membranes extracted and dilatation of intrahepatic ducts, with no against entries.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and detailed for evidence, including the extraction of mucinous fluid and membranes, which is a key finding in the vignette.
